new.s: By what name were the 108 Saiva temples built by Vijayaditya II known?
new.x: Vijayaditya II (Narendra Mrigaraja) built 108 Saiva temples called Narendreswara or Narendra Mrigeswaralayas, recorded in the Sataluru inscription.
new.angle: U0079 #2 / PYQ 108 Saiva temples -> Vijayaditya II

new.s: Why did Vijayaditya II build 108 Saiva temples?
o: To mark his coronation at Vengi
For the Chola soldiers who fell in war
To celebrate his victory over the Kalyani Chalukyas
new.x: Vijayaditya II fought 108 battles in 12 years and built 108 Saiva temples as penance. The Kalidindi temples for fallen Chola soldiers were Rajaraja Narendra's.
new.angle: U0079 #2 / PYQ 108 Saiva temples -> Vijayaditya II

new.s:
Match the following:
List-I (Temple)
A. 108 Saiva temples
B. Pancharamas
C. Kunti Madhava temple, Pithapuram
D. Kartikeya temple, Bezawada
List-II (Builder)
1. Kubja Vishnuvardhana
2. Vijayaditya II

new.x: Vijayaditya II built the 108 Saiva temples, Chalukya Bhima I the Pancharamas, Kubja Vishnuvardhana the Kunti Madhava temple and Yuddhamalla the Kartikeya temple at Bezawada.

new.s: From which royal title did Rajahmundry get its name?
new.x: Ammaraja I bore the title Rajamahendra; Rajamahendravaram (Rajahmundry) is named after it.

new.s: Which city became the third capital of the Eastern Chalukyas, after Pithapuram and Vengi?
new.x: The capitals moved from Pithapuram to Vengi and then to Rajamahendravaram, which Ammaraja I made the capital.

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Ammaraja I made Rajamahendravaram the capital of the Eastern Chalukyas.
2. Rajaraja Narendra ruled from Rajahmundry and made it famous.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Ammaraja I made Rajamahendravaram the capital, and Rajaraja Narendra later ruled from it and made it famous.

new.s: Which town did Gunaga Vijayaditya III develop as another Bejawada?
new.x: Gunaga Vijayaditya III developed Kandukuru (Kandukur) on the model of Bejawada.

new.s: Which title was assumed by Gunaga Vijayaditya III?
new.x: Gunaga Vijayaditya III took the title Tripura Martya Maheshwara. Kollabhiganda was Vijayaditya IV, Rajamahendra Ammaraja I and Vishamasiddhi Kubja Vishnuvardhana.
new.angle: U0079 #11 / PYQ Tripura Martya Maheshwara -> Gunaga Vijayaditya

new.s: Gunaga Vijayaditya III's victories over Kiranapuram and Achalapuram are linked with which of his titles?
new.x: The title Tripura Martya Maheshwara marks Gunaga Vijayaditya III's victories over three cities, including Kiranapuram and Achalapuram.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Gunaga Vijayaditya III:
1. He is regarded as the greatest king of the Eastern Chalukyas.
2. His commander Pandaranga issued the Addanki inscription.
3. He made Rajamahendravaram his capital.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Gunaga Vijayaditya III was the greatest Eastern Chalukya king and Pandaranga was his commander. Rajamahendravaram was made capital by Ammaraja I.
new.angle: U0079 #15 / PYQ greatest Eastern Chalukya king

new.s: Who was the court singer and dancer of Chalukya Bhima I?
new.x: Chellavva was the court singer and dancer of Chalukya Bhima I. Chamekamba was a courtesan linked with Ammaraja II.

new.s: Which title did Chellavva, the court singer of Chalukya Bhima I, hold?
new.x: Chellavva held the title Gandharva-Vidya-Visarada (also Samasta Gandharva Vidyakovida).

new.s: Who was the court poet of Rajaraja Narendra who began the Andhra Mahabharatamu?
new.x: Nannaya Bhattaraka, court poet of Rajaraja Narendra, began the Andhra Mahabharatamu.

new.s: Which Eastern Chalukya ruler had the title 'Kavyageetha Priyudu'?
new.x: Rajaraja Narendra, the patron of Nannaya, was called Kavyageetha Priyudu.
new.angle: U0079 #3 / PYQ patron of Telugu poets (Nannaya, Pavuluri Mallana)

new.s: Which Eastern Chalukya ruler issued the Magallu inscription, the first to mention the Kakatiyas?
new.x: The Magallu inscription of Danarnava is the first record to mention the Kakatiyas.
new.angle: U0079 PYQ ya2c78ad2196 Kakatiyas and the Eastern Chalukyas

new.s: Chellavva of the Eastern Chalukya court is known by which title?
new.x: Chellavva, court singer of Chalukya Bhima I, had the title Gandharva-vidya-visarada. Kavi Vrishabha was Bhattavamana's title.

new.s: Who was the father of Chellavva, compared to Tumburu in the Attili inscription?
new.x: The Attili inscription compares Mallappa, Chellavva's father, to Tumburu.

new.s: What is the subject of Ugradityacharya's Kalyanakaraka?
new.x: Kalyanakaraka is a Jain Ayurvedic book on diagnosis and treatment, written by Ugradityacharya.

new.s: Who were the Panchanamvaru, who appear as an organised body from the Eastern Chalukya period?
o: Five merchant guilds of the ports
new.x: Panchanamvaru were the five artisan groups: blacksmith, goldsmith, brazier, carpenter and sculptor.
new.angle: U0080 #5 Society - caste groups in inscriptions

new.s: Which place was the headquarters of the merchant guilds in medieval Andhra?
new.x: Penugonda was the headquarters of the merchant guilds in medieval Andhra.

new.s: In Eastern Chalukya grants, Udranga was a tax on what?
new.x: In Eastern Chalukya grants Udranga is read as a water tax; in Gupta records it is usually the land tax.

new.s: Between which rivers did the Raichur Doab lie?
new.x: The Raichur Doab (Raichur Antarvedi) lay between the Krishna and the Tungabhadra; it is not the Krishna-Godavari doab.

new.s: The Raichur Doab was the main cause of wars between which powers?
new.x: The fertile and strategic Raichur Doab was the main cause of the Bahmani-Vijayanagara wars, from Harihara I's time.

new.s: Which lake is named in the Pithapuram inscription of Velanati Prithvisvara?
new.x: The Pithapuram inscription of the Velanati chief Prithvisvara names Kolleru Lake.
new.angle: U0084 #1 Velanati Chodas - Pithapuram inscription names Kolleru

new.s: Who was the minister of Nalagamaraju in the Palnadu war?
new.x: Nagamma (Nayakuralu) was Nalagamaraju's minister; Brahmanaidu led the rival Malideva faction.

new.s: The Palnadu war arose from the rivalry between whom?
new.x: The Palnadu war grew out of the rivalry of Nayakuralu Nagamma and Brahmanaidu, ministers of the two factions.
new.angle: U0084 #2 / PYQ y7b68c74e49c cause of the Palnadu war

new.s: Whose daughter did Satyamartanda, founder of the Matsyas of Oddadi, marry?
new.x: Satyamartanda married Prabhavati, daughter of Jayatsena of Utkala (Odisha), who made him ruler of the Oddadi country.
new.angle: U0084 #5 Matsyas of Oddadi - origin legend

new.s: Which part of Andhra did the Matsyas of Oddadi rule?
new.x: The Matsyas of Oddadi ruled the upland Srikakulam–Vizianagaram zone of northern Andhra, near Anakapalle.
